discourse.excerpt: You have to recognise that life is meant for selfless service and not to be lived for selfish purposes. Only through such service can the oneness of mankind be experienced.
discourse.occasion: Inaugural discourse at the All India Sai Active Workers' conference
discourse.theme: Life is meant for selfless service — and the worthiest service goes to the helpless, the Daridra-Narayana.
discourse.title: Born to Serve

reflection: Swami is unequivocal: life is meant for selfless service, not selfish purposes — and the worthiest service is rendered not to the powerful but to the helpless, the Daridra-Narayana, those neglected by the world. This week, find one small act of service for someone worse off than you, and offer it as service to the Narayana dwelling within them. That is Karma Yoga. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 20, 19 Nov 1987)
seva_nudge: Serve one meal, or offer one hour of help, to someone who cannot repay you — the weak, the destitute, the neglected.

video.title: How Service Purifies the Heart | Karma Marga Wisdom from Sathya Sai 100th Birthday Panel
